soru: Açık radyo erişim ağlarında (O-RAN) makine öğrenmesi kullanımı, mimariler ve zorluklar üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Açık radyo erişim ağlarında (O-RAN) makine öğrenmesi kullanımı, mimariler ve zorluklar üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-02-27. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Understanding O-RAN: Architecture, Interfaces, Algorithms, Security, and Research Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: This is the standard tutorial on O-RAN. It covers the architecture, the RICs, AI/ML workflows, security and open research problems.

calismalar.baslik: Intelligence and Learning in O-RAN for Data-driven NextG Cellular Networks
calismalar.gerekce: A foundational paper on data-driven control at different timescales in O-RAN, with deep reinforcement learning xApps tested experimentally.

calismalar.baslik: O-RAN: Disrupting the Virtualized RAN Ecosystem
calismalar.gerekce: An early, widely cited overview of the O-RAN architecture, its interfaces and an AI/ML use case.

calismalar.baslik: ColO-RAN: Developing Machine Learning-based xApps for Open RAN Closed-loop Control on Programmable Experimental Platforms
calismalar.gerekce: The first large-scale public O-RAN framework for developing and testing ML-based xApps.

calismalar.baslik: Intelligent O-RAN for Beyond 5G and 6G Wireless Networks
calismalar.gerekce: An early paper on intelligent radio resource management in O-RAN, including a discussion of open problems.

calismalar.baslik: Deep Learning for B5G Open Radio Access Network: Evolution, Survey, Case Studies, and Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: A survey that maps deep learning solutions onto the O-RAN architecture and discusses MLOps and open challenges.

calismalar.baslik: Toward Next Generation Open Radio Access Networks: What O-RAN Can and Cannot Do!
calismalar.gerekce: Identifies the limits of O-RAN, including testing of AI-based control applications, real-time physical-layer control and security.

calismalar.baslik: OpenRAN Gym: AI/ML Development, Data Collection, and Testing for O-RAN on PAWR Platforms
calismalar.gerekce: An open toolbox for data collection and for training and testing xApps on PAWR testbeds.

calismalar.baslik: dApps: Distributed Applications for Real-time Inference and Control in O-RAN
calismalar.gerekce: Introduces dApps, which bring real-time (under 10 ms) AI inference and control to the CU and DU.

calismalar.baslik: Programmable and Customized Intelligence for Traffic Steering in 5G Networks Using Open RAN Architectures
calismalar.gerekce: Presents the ns-O-RAN simulation environment and a deep reinforcement learning traffic-steering xApp trained on large-scale data.

calismalar.baslik: Empowering the 6G Cellular Architecture with Open RAN
calismalar.gerekce: A vision paper on AI-driven closed-loop control and Open RAN principles as a basis for 6G.

calismalar.baslik: Toward Integrating Intelligence and Programmability in Open Radio Access Networks: A Comprehensive Survey
calismalar.gerekce: A broad survey of AI use cases and deployment scenarios in O-RAN.

calismalar.baslik: Explainable AI in 6G O-RAN: A Tutorial and Survey on Architecture, Use Cases, Challenges, and Future Research
calismalar.gerekce: A survey on making the AI/ML decisions taken by the RICs explainable and trustworthy.

calismalar.baslik: Open RAN xApps Design and Evaluation: Lessons Learnt and Identified Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: Reports practical problems and ambiguities in xApp and rApp development, based on industry experience.

calismalar.baslik: PandORA: Automated Design and Comprehensive Evaluation of Deep Reinforcement Learning Agents for Open RAN
calismalar.gerekce: A systematic study of how to design and evaluate deep reinforcement learning xApps.

calismalar.baslik: EdgeRIC: Empowering Realtime Intelligent Optimization and Control in NextG Networks
calismalar.gerekce: Shows real-time AI control that the near-RT RIC's latency cannot reach, at sub-millisecond scale.

calismalar.baslik: FlexRIC: An SDK for next-generation SD-RANs
calismalar.gerekce: An efficient open-source near-RT RIC/SDK widely used to deploy ML xApps.

calismalar.baslik: Recent Advances in Machine Learning for Network Automation in the O-RAN
calismalar.gerekce: A current survey of ML-based network automation in O-RAN and its challenges.

calismalar.baslik: A Survey on Open Radio Access Networks: Challenges, Research Directions, and Open Source Approaches
calismalar.gerekce: Collects open challenges, research directions and open-source tools for O-RAN.

calismalar.baslik: Open RAN Security: Challenges and Opportunities
calismalar.gerekce: A key survey of O-RAN security threats, including attack surfaces on AI/ML components.

calismalar.baslik: Colosseum: The Open RAN Digital Twin
calismalar.gerekce: A digital-twin approach for training and testing AI/ML models without risk to live networks.

calismalar.baslik: Actor-Critic Network for O-RAN Resource Allocation: xApp Design, Deployment, and Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: Describes the full design and deployment process for an RL-based xApp.

calismalar.baslik: Federated Deep Reinforcement Learning for Resource Allocation in O-RAN Slicing
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes federated deep reinforcement learning to coordinate multiple independent xApps.

calismalar.baslik: Conflict Mitigation Framework and Conflict Detection in O-RAN Near-RT RIC
calismalar.gerekce: Addresses conflicts between ML xApps, an open problem in multi-vendor intelligence.

calismalar.baslik: Experimental Study of Adversarial Attacks on ML-based xApps in O-RAN
calismalar.gerekce: Demonstrates experimentally that ML xApps are vulnerable to adversarial attacks through the shared RIC database.

calismalar.baslik: System-level Analysis of Adversarial Attacks and Defenses on Intelligence in O-RAN based Cellular Networks
calismalar.gerekce: Analyzes adversarial attacks on O-RAN intelligence and defenses such as distillation at the system level.

calismalar.baslik: ORAN-Bench-13K: An Open Source Benchmark for Assessing LLMs in Open Radio Access Networks
calismalar.gerekce: The first broad benchmark for evaluating LLMs on O-RAN knowledge.

calismalar.baslik: Artificial Intelligence in Open Radio Access Network
calismalar.gerekce: An early tutorial on integrating AI/ML into O-RAN, with a focus on security.

calismalar.baslik: Beyond Connectivity: An Open Architecture for AI-RAN Convergence in 6G
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes a converged O-RAN/AI-RAN architecture that runs AI and telecom workloads on shared infrastructure.

calismalar.baslik: ORANSight-2.0: Foundational LLMs for O-RAN
calismalar.gerekce: Develops O-RAN-specific foundation LLMs, a new direction for generative AI in O-RAN.
